mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not trend downward over the past 12 months or SPX 20d returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.0% signals tightening labor markets, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 4.0% within the next month or SPX 20d returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of a declining federal funds rate and rising quarterly demand (GDPC1) signals an expansionary monetary and economic cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month and GDPC1 > previous month
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS does not decline or GDPC1 does not rise in the same period, or SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 102.5 in a late-cycle expansion signals weakening supply-side growth, reducing future earnings growth prospects and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not fall below 102.5 in a late-cycle expansion or SPX 20d returns in late-cycle periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in CPIAUCSL below 330 signals lower inflation expectations from monetary policy easing, reducing risk premium pressures and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not fall below 330 or SPX 60d returns in easing periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of rising demand (HOUST) and declining federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signals expansionary conditions, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month and FEDFUNDS < previous month
failure_condition: Either HOUST does not rise or FEDFUNDS does not fall in the same period, or SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in demand (GDPC1) signals robust corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth reverses in the next quarter or SPX 5d returns in growth periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of rising demand (HOUST) and falling unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) signals expansionary labor market conditions and strong corporate demand, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either HOUST does not rise or UNRATE does not fall below 4.0% in the same period, or SPX 20d returns in post-recession recovery are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
